title: Your Teen Is Stuck on an Assignment but Won’t Ask the Teacher for Help
summary: Help your teen turn one confusing assignment into a private, specific teacher request they can own—without taking over.
seo_title: Teen Won’t Ask for Help: Parent Plan
seo_description: Help your teen ask a teacher about one confusing assignment using TRY → ASK → NEXT, while you coach without taking over routine contact or sending it yourself.
release_move: The parent helps identify one stuck point and shape one specific request; the teenager chooses the practical channel and makes routine contact when able.

core_belief_shift.from: If my teen will not ask the teacher alone, I must either rescue them or leave them to fail.
core_belief_shift.to: I can coach one clear request, let my teen own routine contact, and step in proportionately for access, unresolved school response, or safety.

book_relevance.reason: The Social Playbook is an optional teen-owned tool for practising calm requests to adults; the parent guide remains complete without it.

next_step.label: Help your advice land without taking over
next_step.reason: Use this next when practical help at home starts sounding like criticism to your teen.

hero.alt: A teenager pauses over an unfinished assignment while a parent sits nearby, offering support without taking over.
